kicker: What a decision model cannot do

scenes.headline: What a decision model cannot do, and why
scenes.sub: One architectural choice, two opposite prices, and a lot of misfiling.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Rocket! Decision models like Jev pick an answer from a list you send. Here's what that shape rules out, and what it only seems to.

scenes.text: A decision model's output is one element of the caller's option set. Two limits follow from that; the rest are prices or misfiling.
scenes.mark: one element of the caller's option set
scenes.say: A generative model's output is its vocabulary, sampled again and again. A decision model's output is one item from the list you sent.

scenes.title: Count what comes back
scenes.say: Why can't it write a string, or plan? Count the output.

parts.note: the most options one Choice can carry
parts.say: A Choice carries at most two hundred and fifty-five options.

parts.note: all that returns: no text, no state
parts.say: So one call returns about eight bits. No text, and no scratchpad to carry a plan into the next call.

left.title: Score each option alone
items: Each option encoded on its own
A question spanning two options: unanswerable
left.say: Score each option alone, and order can't matter. But a question that spans two options has nothing to find. Jev scores zero of a hundred.

right.title: Options share one context
items: Options sit in one prompt, as letters
Relational questions become at least answerable
right.say: Share one context, and relational questions become at least answerable. But position gets a prior: slot A is worth about one point seven logits.

scenes.title: The design rule: enumerate, decide, compose
scenes.say: So the limits are a specification. The vendor's own docs give the rule.

items.say: Something enumerates a finite answer set: a regex, the page's tools, a component catalog.
The model picks within it, so it can't invent a value or transpose a digit.
Then code, or a generative model, composes the result.

scenes.text: Put the bounded model where the answer set is already finite, and where something else owns the composition.

recap: The output is one of your options
Isolate or share: two opposite prices
scenes.say: To recap: one option out, two opposite prices, and a rule: enumerate, decide, compose.
